SP/FA MT1 [Hexa 2]

Reading

PLUM Reading 2 Unit 1~Unit 3 · Choose the correct answer.

Unit 1

It is a beautiful day.
Olsen’s family goes on a picnic.
Mother is cold.
She puts a T-shirt on Olsen.
Father is cold.
He puts a sweater on Olsen.
Sister is cold.
She puts a jacket on Olsen.
Brother is cold.
He puts a scarf and socks on Olsen.
Olsen cannot move!
The family is cold.
They go home.
1. What does Mother put on Olsen?
A) a T-shirt
B) a sweater
C) a scarf
D) socks
2. Who puts a jacket on Olsen?
A) Mother
B) Father
C) Sister
D) Brother
3. Why does the family go home?
A) The family is cold.
B) The family is sleepy.
C) It is a beautiful day.
D) It is a bad day.

Unit 2

It is sunny.
The sun shines.
We feel the sunlight.

It is rainy.
The rain drops.
We feel the rain.

It is windy.
The wind blows.
We feel the wind.

It is snowy.
The snow falls.
We feel the snow.

How is the weather today?
1. What is the story about?
A) snow
B) family
C) sunlight
D) weather
2. What shines in the sky?
A) the sun
B) the rain
C) the wind
D) the snow
3. When do we feel the wind?
A) when it shines
B) when it drops
C) when it blows
D) when it falls

Unit 3

Alien 1: Look at the Earth! Many things have wheels!
Alien 1: Does a bicycle have wheels?
Alien 2: Yes. A bicycle has two wheels.
Alien 1: Does a car have wheels?
Alien 2: Yes. A car has four wheels.
Alien 1: Does a truck have wheels?
Alien 2: Yes. A truck has six wheels.
Alien 1: Do inline skates have wheels?
Alien 2: Yes. Inline skates have eight wheels.
Alien 1: Does a train have wheels?
Alien 2: Yes. A train has many wheels.
Alien 1: Does a boat have wheels?
Alien 2: No. A boat has no wheels.
Alien 1: Wrong! This boat has wheels!
1. How many wheels does a truck have?
A) two
B) four
C) six
D) eight
2. What has eight wheels?
A) a bicycle
B) inline skates
C) a train
D) a boat
3. What is special about this boat?
A) It has wheels.
B) It has no wheels.
C) It can fly.
D) It is big.
